CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deliveries (
                    event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    topic TEXT NOT NULL,
                    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
                        state IN (
                            'PENDING',
                            'CONFIRMED',
                            'UNCERTAIN'
                        )
                    ),
                    partition_id INTEGER,
                    offset_id INTEGER,
                    CHECK (
                        state != 'CONFIRMED'
                        OR (
                            partition_id IS NOT NULL
                            AND offset_id IS NOT NULL
                        )
                    )
                )

INSERT INTO deliveries(
                    event_id,
                    topic,
                    state,
                    content_sha256
                )
                VALUES (?, ?, 'PENDING', ?)

SELECT topic, state
                FROM deliveries
                WHERE event_id=?

SELECT topic, state, content_sha256
                FROM deliveries
                WHERE event_id=?
